channel.title: Last Attempt: A World of Warcraft Guildcast
channel.description:
Last Attempt is a World of Warcraft guildcast focused on the week-to-week reality of mythic progression with our guild SECOND ATTEMPT: raid nights, Mythic+ runs, roster changes, patch and expansion updates, and the lessons learned between pulls. Each episode mixes practical discussion and strategy with guild culture—what’s working, what isn’t, and what we’re doing next.
If you care about organized progression, improving your play, and the social side of WoW, this is the show.

item.title: Last Attempt Guildcast — BlizzCon Recap + Classic+ Is FOREVER + Undead Paladins + WoW News — 032
item.description:
Welcome to the Last Attempt Guildcast. In this episode, Squirrelthug is

joined again by guildmate Templrivanho for our first live video cast, and our longest episode yet, all about World of Warcraft at BlizzCon 2026. Fresh back from the con, Squirrelthug shares stories from the show floor, from Darkmoon Faire lines the fire marshal kept shutting down to free tattoos and a D&D one-shot run by Blizzard developers. Then we dig into Midnight: Eclipse — the Mantle Vault, the Worldcore raid, and the first Legendary of the Worldsoul Saga — plus Astalor becoming the Season 3 Delve Nemesis, a dungeon pool the crowd booed, spec-based Mythic+ rewards, and Night Elf, Troll, and Forsaken Paladins. We also cover housing mannequins, the new Calibration Chamber, Talebound, a Wrath of the Lich King Remix on the roadmap, and a long stretch on World of Warcraft: Forever — Classic+ launching November 4 with no realms, last names, 10, 20, and 40-player raids, the Legacy System, hardcore characters that can transfer on death, campfires, opt-in transmog, and a flat GDKP ban.



Topics:

• BlizzCon 2026 From the Show Floor

• Midnight: Eclipse & the Worldcore Raid

• Season 3: Astalor & the Dungeon Pool

• Three New Paladin Races

• Talebound & the Road to The Last Titan

• WoW Forever: Classic+ Is Real

item.description: Welcome to the Last Attempt Guildcast. In this episode, Squirrelthug is joined again by guildmate Templrivanho, back on the panel after a week away. We open on week one of the Venomous Abyss closing as the slowest opening tier since Liberation of Undermine — Method finishing the week ahead at 5/9 Mythic while Liquid spent five days on Heroic splits, Blizzard cutting Malacrass's phase three bonus health from 35% down to 19%, and Liquid picking up a lair world first on Nymrissa Wavecaller. We get into a genuinely rough week for crafting, where submitted work orders are vanishing and taking Sparks and Mythic Crests with them, with customer support confirming it's a bug and having no way to restore what you lost. Also the 113,411 players who earned Fabled Vanquisher in week one against roughly four thousand who made the cut last season, bonus roll lockouts going live days before the announced date with no warning at all, an intermission bug that bricks Coiled Altar if your raid does too much damage, the campaign finale and its Dawn's Radiance sword, rock climbing back on the Coiled Isle, and an Ulduar timewalking week worth running for the loot sharing alone. item.title: Last Attempt Guildcast — Method WORLD FIRST + Coiled Altar GUTTED + Evokers BROKEN + WoW News — 029
item.description:
Last Attempt Guildcast — Method WORLD FIRST + Coiled Altar GUTTED + Evokers BROKEN + WoW News — 029


Welcome to the Last Attempt Guildcast. In this episode, Squirrelthug is flying solo — Templrivanho couldn't make it this week, so this one is a shorter, looser run through the news, recorded Tuesday and landing a day late. We open on the Race to World First, where the Venomous Abyss has produced the longest race since Shadowlands and Method took their first world first in years on Vashnik the Malignant by working out that his red zone is the one you never touch. We get into the Coiled Altar hotfix that stripped roughly a hundred percentage points of hidden health off both bosses on every difficulty, a genuinely stacked week of free gearing between the campaign ring, uncapped Mistcrests off a single Cracked Keystone, and a three-week PvP chain for Hero-track jewelry — plus the Spark catch-up fix that shipped bugged for the second week running. Also the Prey questline's permanent portal to the Coiled Isle, Corrosive Souls being warbound and how to actually bank them, a rough week for Evokers who are disconnecting every few minutes off Battle Visage, a world quest that quietly wrecked people's turn speed, Jimothy turning out not to be in the game at all, and the BlizzCon 2026 Legends lineup with a McDonald's Happy Meal mount chaser.


Topics:

• Method's First World First in Years

• Coiled Altar Massively Nerfed

• Week One Gearing, and Another Spark Bug

item.title: Last Attempt Guildcast — Vanilla's CUT Content + Mounts REVOKED + Spark Chaos + WoW News — 028
item.description:
Welcome to the Last Attempt Guildcast. In this episode, Squirrelthug is joined again by guildmate Templrivanho. We dig into the community case that content Blizzard cut from Vanilla is turning up in Classic Plus — and why the slow mounts, long walks, and attunements everyone remembers might be the entire point rather than something to sand off. We also unpack a genuinely messy week for gearing, where a leftover Midnight: World Tour turn-in handed some characters a third Spark of Tides and Blizzard's fix was to give everybody four at the August 18 reset, the Season 2 tier lists landing right on top of two rounds of trinket hotfixes, and Mythic L'ura mounts being pulled off accounts for policy violations that appear to be catching players who paid in gold rather than real money. Plus the Tettles interview with the encounter designers, bonus rolls getting reshuffled and then quietly trimmed before they even unlock, the hidden Slitherfang pet the secret finders cracked, four new housing Endeavors — one of which drops a portal to the Coiled Isle in your neighborhood — and Blizzard closing FY26 as the top-performing studio in Xbox's division.


Topics:

• Vanilla's Cut Content in Classic Plus

• Mythic L'ura Mounts Revoked

• Spark Chaos & Week Zero Gearing

• Season 2 Tier Lists & Hotfixes
